result.instructions: Tools for Close, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which leads are in the Proposal status, and who owns them?"; "Find the lead for Acme Corp and show its latest activity."; "Add a note to the Globex lead: called, asked for pricing, follow up Monday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Close data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run close_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run close_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run close_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. close_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: close_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected user
tools.description: Show the Close user and organization this API key belongs to. Good first call to confirm the connection. Close API: GET /me/.

tools.name: close_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (sales reps and admins) in the organization. Use their ids as assigned_to. Close API: GET /user/.

tools.name: close_list_lead_statuses
tools.title: List lead statuses
tools.description: List the lead statuses of the organization, in order. Use their ids as status_id. Close API: GET /status/lead/.

tools.name: close_list_opportunity_statuses
tools.title: List opportunity statuses
tools.description: List the opportunity statuses (pipeline stages) of the organization. Close API: GET /status/opportunity/.

tools.name: close_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the opportunity pipelines and the statuses in each. Close API: GET /pipeline/.

tools.name: close_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads (companies or accounts) in the organization, one page at a time. Use close_search_leads to find a lead by name. Close API: GET /lead/.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

tools.name: close_get_lead
tools.title: Get a lead
tools.description: Fetch one lead with its name, status, addresses and custom fields. Close API: GET /lead/{id}/.

lead_id.description: Lead id (for example lead_… or user_…).

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

tools.name: close_search_leads
tools.title: Search leads by name
tools.description: Find leads whose name contains every word in the text (full words). Uses Close's Advanced Filtering. Close API: POST /data/search/.

text.description: Words to find in the lead name, for example Acme Corp.

tools.name: close_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people), optionally only those on one lead. Close API: GET /contact/.

lead_id.description: Lead id to filter by (for example lead_… or user_…).

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

tools.name: close_list_opportunities
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: List opportunities (deals), optionally filtered by lead or status. Close API: GET /opportunity/.

lead_id.description: Lead id to filter by (for example lead_… or user_…).

status_id.description: Opportunity status id to filter by.

tools.name: close_list_activities
tools.title: List activities on a lead
tools.description: List the activity timeline of one lead: notes, calls, emails, status changes. Close API: GET /activity/ with lead_id.

lead_id.description: Lead id (for example lead_… or user_…).

tools.name: close_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List lead tasks (action items with a due date), optionally filtered by lead, assignee or completion. Close API: GET /task/.

lead_id.description: Lead id to filter by (for example lead_… or user_…).

assigned_to.description: User id of the assignee to filter by.

is_complete.description: true for completed tasks only, false for open tasks only.

tools.name: close_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: Create a lead (a company or account). Close API: POST /lead/. Creates a record; no delete tool exists.

name.description: Lead name, usually a company name.

url.description: Website of the lead, for example https://example.com.

status_id.description: Lead status id. Defaults to the organization's first status.

tools.name: close_update_lead
tools.title: Update a lead
tools.description: Change the name, website, description or status of a lead. Only the fields you pass change. Close API: PUT /lead/{id}/.

lead_id.description: Lead id (for example lead_… or user_…).

tools.name: close_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Add a contact (a person) to a lead. Close API: POST /contact/.

lead_id.description: Lead id to add the contact to; omit to create a new lead for the contact (for example lead_… or user_…).

emails.description: Email addresses, each with an optional type such as office or direct.

phones.description: Phone numbers in international format, each with an optional type.

tools.name: close_create_note
tools.title: Add a note to a lead
tools.description: Add a plain-text note to a lead's activity timeline. Close API: POST /activity/note/.

lead_id.description: Lead id (for example lead_… or user_…).

contact_id.description: Contact id the note is about. The contact must be on the lead.

annotations.title: Add a note to a lead

tools.name: close_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task on a lead with an optional due date and assignee. Close may email the assignee. Close API: POST /task/.

lead_id.description: Lead id (for example lead_… or user_…).

assigned_to.description: User id of the assignee. Defaults to the API key's user.

is_complete.description: true to create the task already completed.

disable_notification.description: true to skip the email to the assignee.

tools.name: close_update_task
tools.title: Complete or reassign a task
tools.description: Mark a task complete or open again, or change its assignee. Close API: PUT /task/{id}/.

task_id.description: Task id (for example lead_… or user_…).

is_complete.description: true to complete the task, false to reopen it.

assigned_to.description: User id of the new assignee.

tools.name: close_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create a deal (opportunity) on a lead, with an optional value in cents, status and win likelihood. Close API: POST /opportunity/.

lead_id.description: Lead id (for example lead_… or user_…).

status_id.description: Opportunity status id or label, for example Active.

value.description: Amount in cents, for example 340000 for $3,400.00.

value_period.description: How often the value is paid.

contact_id.description: Contact id on the lead to link.

tools.name: close_update_opportunity
tools.title: Update an opportunity
tools.description: Move an opportunity to another status, or change its value, likelihood or note. Only the fields you pass change. Close API: PUT /opportunity/{id}/.

opportunity_id.description: Opportunity id (for example lead_… or user_…).

status_id.description: New status id or label, for example Won.

value.description: Amount in cents, for example 340000 for $3,400.00.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Close
prompts.description: What you can do with Close here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_a_lead_and_its_latest_activity
prompts.title: Find a lead and its latest activity
prompts.description: Search leads by name, then open one to read its status and custom fields. List its activity timeline of notes, calls and emails.

prompts.name: review_pipelines_and_open_deals
prompts.title: Review pipelines and open deals
prompts.description: List the pipelines and their stages. List the opportunities, filtered by lead or status, to see the open deals.

prompts.name: log_a_call_note_on_a_lead
prompts.title: Log a call note on a lead
prompts.description: Add a plain-text note to a lead's activity timeline, such as a call summary. This server has no tool to edit or delete a note.

prompts.name: create_a_follow_up_task
prompts.title: Create a follow-up task
prompts.description: Create a task on a lead with a due date and an assignee. Close may email the assignee. Complete a task or reassign it later.

prompts.name: move_a_deal_to_another_stage
prompts.title: Move a deal to another stage
prompts.description: Change the status, value, likelihood or note of an opportunity. Only the fields you pass change.

prompts.name: add_a_lead_and_its_contact_person
prompts.title: Add a lead and its contact person
prompts.description: Create a lead, which is a company or an account. Then add a contact person to it.
